notes.title: 🔴 August Update – Release Date Trailer This Month!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/0429b09d06dd616fd695274a57d90d5d8c759111.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Welcome Telegraphists![/h2][p]It's August and development continues at full pace, and so does the march of new features, locations and language support for the full game! Here's a glimpse at what's been unfolding behind the curtain.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Gameplay Mechanic: [b]Jamming[/b][/h2][p]We're currently prototyping a tense new gameplay feature: [b]Jamming[/b]. In these new levels, you'll have to disrupt Soviet transmissions before they reach enemy ears at the frontline.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/68d9a28c5e9a6c057b63a8284f7122ba8e7c1c54.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Gameplay Location: [b]Zhytomyr[/b][/h2][p]Introducing our fourth gameplay location: [b]Zhytomyr[/b]. Join Senior Telegraphist Feliks Hladny near the Ukrainian frontline, a key position under Soviet attack. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/f4e2725b4d2eac1cdc3d64e79f449f09b165339f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Japanese Localization[/h2][p]We're thrilled to announce that [b]Japanese localization[/b] will be available from [b]day one[/b] in the full game! We're still working on an update for the demo to include the new localization, which may be available later this year in an [b]Open Beta[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/6b21833518eeff842e2a6e1d589a8a581381b03e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🎥 New Trailer This Month![/h2][p]The art for our release date trailer is officially complete! It's now on the editing table where we're piecing everything together. As a preview of what's to come, here's a still from one of the scenes. Keep an eye on our [url="https://discord.gg/J9rtH5rVun"]Discord server[/url] for the exclusive announcement![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/53818024c60b29e1f6eedd931aaae0f5a6d89946.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's next?[/h2][p]We're finalizing the environment art and will soon be introducing new characters and updating existing ones - each with detailed poses that will change during conversations.[/p][p]And as we speak, we're recording new voicelines with some familiar voices joining the cast. But no spoilers - you'll meet them in-character in [i]Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War[/i] :)[/p][p] [/p][h2]🔥 Add to Wishlist🔥[/h2][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584510"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][p][/p][h2]🌐 Join the Community![/h2][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][list][*][p] [b]💬 Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.gg/J9rtH5rVun"]https://discord.gg/J9rtH5rVun[/url] [/p][/*][*][p] [b]📰 Mailing List (Newsletter): [/b][url="https://telegraphist1920.com"]https://telegraphist1920.com[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Previous Update[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2584510/announcements/detail/500576552635859359"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]More updates soon ~ Godspeed! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: ☀️ June Update – New Demo This Saturday!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/0429b09d06dd616fd695274a57d90d5d8c759111.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Greetings Telegraphists![/h2][p]We've been hard at work refining the upcoming [b]Boss Level[/b] we've teased earlier.[/p][p]In this new level, you'll face off against Soviet commander [url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikhail_Tukhachevsky"]Mikhail Tukhachevsky[/url] and his troops marked on tactical map.[/p][p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/ef7d95bde178f2430e4b4656c0f60d9df790de3e.png[/img][/p][p]Above, you can also see Polish commander [url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%B3zef_Pi%C5%82sudski"]Józef Piłsudski[/url] and his troops engaging in battle, while borders shift accordingly to the occupied land.[/p][p][/p][h3]New gameplay mechanic - Receiving[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/29594d654d7864a9a60cc1a89dbaddde25e01d8b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The new level will also introduce a brand-new gameplay mechanic: Receiving[/b]. This will challenge your memory skills to listen carefully and repeat incoming Morse code messages.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 New Demo Update - v. 0.19 🔥[/h3][p]After extensive improvements and bug-fixes, we're excited to announce that the Boss Level is confirmed to drop on [b]June 28th (this Saturday) at 10 AM PT[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3]A Glimpse into the Full Game: Warsaw Citadel Courtyard[/h3][p]We're also excited to share a sneak peek at one of the locations from the full game: the [b]Courtyard of Warsaw Citadel[/b], a perfect place to take a break and feast your eyes on the panorama of Warsaw at night.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/0f2d1da54eea5a5cab0a53989d76a84f59f52cac.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Mastermind: Kowalewski's Office[/h3][p]You might be wondering, who is Kowalewski? Jan Kowalewski was a key historical figure - the man who broke Soviet ciphers and changed the course of the war. In Telegraphist 1920, he will be your mentor, guiding you as you hone your skills to decipher crucial Soviet messages.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's a look at his workplace... a perfect mess for a master codebreaker 😎[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/911ec7d5c1a78b8c09bdffff1237407c3099ceb7.png"][/img][/p][p]You can read more about the brilliant Jan Kowalewski here: [url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jan_Kowalewski"]https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jan_Kowalewski[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]🎥 New Trailer Coming Soon![/h3][p]We are currently working on a new trailer in cooperation with the very talented voice actor, Tim Plewman. You may recognize his voice from our previous story trailer:[/p][previewyoutube="ziMTKv7o8Ec;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here's an exclusive frame from the new trailer we're currently producing behind the scenes:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/220b499358a349341432d38b797a0128d2324d09.png"][/img][/p][p]This upcoming trailer will officially announce the full game's release date, so keep your eyes peeled! 👀
We'll be dropping the trailer on our [url="https://discord.gg/J9rtH5rVun"][b]Discord server[/b][/url][b] [/b]first[b]. [/b]Join our community so you won't miss it![/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 Wishlist on Steam 🔥[/h2][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584510"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][p][/p][h2]🌐 Join the Community![/h2][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][list][*][p] [b]💬 Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.gg/J9rtH5rVun"]https://discord.gg/J9rtH5rVun[/url] [/p][/*][*][p] [b]📰 Mailing List (Newsletter): [/b][url="https://telegraphist1920.com"]https://telegraphist1920.com[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Previous Update[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2584510/view/500569576639037859?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]More updates soon ~ Godspeed! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: 🌸 April Update - New Demo Coming This Month
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/0429b09d06dd616fd695274a57d90d5d8c759111.png[/img]

[h2]Welcome, Telegraphists![/h2]
Today, we bring you something special: the announcement of our new demo! But first, let’s dive into the latest changes and improvements in the game.

[h2]🏆 New Level Ending Screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/44d9ec4328ab3b5268a521f743062990bd8090a1.gif[/img]

As you can see in the GIF above, we’ve streamlined the [b]ranking system[/b], reducing the number of ranks to just 5 for better clarity. And yes, we’re still tweaking the design, so “1” won’t look like “I” in the final version!

[h2]🌍 New location - WW1 Trenches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/9ea2b81b2ea737525ff355f8f3d12e68cf7a27a8.png[/img]
In the early levels of the full game, you’ll be sending messages from within the trenches. While your placement may seem secure, this is the frontline - stay alert, as enemy forces can breach at any moment!

[h2]🎥 3D Cutscene - Siberia[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/3dfe00a4c4e134057408c9c1037dface71b06081.png[/img]
As mentioned in previous devlogs, we’re working on 3D pre-rendered cutscenes, which will seamlessly integrate into our game’s hand-painted visual style. Here's one scene from the first one placed in the Siberia location.

[h2]⚠️ New Demo - 28.04[/h2]
[h3]What’s New?[/h3]
✔ Lviv Citadel HQ with fresh gameplay graphics.
✔ Room Customization - decorate your space with collectibles.
✔ Revamped Level Ending Screen.
✔ Hub Minigames.
✔ Boss Level.
✔ ... and more surprises!

Mark your calendars - [b]April 28th[/b] is when our new content update drops for the demo!

[h2]GDC 2025 Recap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/c29aeb0108bed303e595fc78db7afce61de39317.jpg[/img]
We showcased Telegraphist 1920 at GDC 2025! It was an incredible experience meeting the lead developer of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/774181]Rhythm Doctor[/url] and the creators of  a unique narrative rhythm game with psychedelic twist called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239360]Beat, Heart, Beat[/url]! Check out their demo!

We also had great discussion about the evolution of narrative rhythm games, tracing back to classics like [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PaRappa_the_Rapper]PaRappa the Rapper[/url]. Maybe in the future, we'll host our own narrative-driven rhythm game event, who knows ;)

notes.title: ✍️ New Demo Update: RPG Mastery System
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/e2e427c902a84da6d634a94505236bbcae2cacc9.png[/img]
[h2]New Demo[/h2]
New demo is coming [b]Tomorrow (Friday)[/b] at [b]7 PM GMT[/b]. 

We have worked on so many features that we think you will be very happy with the progress! 

New features include: [b]Mastery System, New Animations, New Optional Tutorials, Full Controller and Steam Deck Support, New iteration of UI/UX[/b] and much more!

[h2]Full Controller and Steam Deck Support[/h2]
[i](Including haptics and vibrations!)[/i]

You can now play the demo with any controller and complete it from start to finish (only the Level Editor remains unsupported!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/26d0dce40be148cb5e3e16ed6c68841efd0f367b.png[/img]
[i](Oh mighty Valve, please add us to your manual queue for Steam Deck Verified! 🙏)[/i]

[h2]New Animations[/h2]
Feel much more dynamic during sudden events, such as reparing the telegraph or changing frequency.

[previewyoutube=xqow9k7YjLM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]RPG Mastery System[/h2]
Recently, we were designing a system that would reward player for learning Morse code and at the same time satisfy rhythm players. Here's what we've come up with...

Based on how many times you tapped properly Morse letters you now gain levels for each of them. You can track the experience points (XP) in the Hub:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/4fa29cf0091a837fdc08572a8cf0f8ea49730759.png[/img]

Here you can see example of Mastery level in action:

[previewyoutube=yV88cfq9phg;full][/previewyoutube]
[i](Also: there will be English translation under Morse code text, if you can read fast enough!)[/i]

As you can see this system could be a great foundation for learning Morse code and at the same time increase difficulty level. 

Just imagine other campaigns made by community trying to convey own messages, tell story with it. Level Editor is already finished to make custom levels, but [b]we will definitely focus on more content for players and Steam Workshop integrity in the near future[/b].

[b]REMEMBER. TOMORROW. AT 7 PM GMT. NEW UPDATE FOR TELEGRAPHIST 1920 DEMO[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2613430/Telegraphist_1920_Beats_of_War_Demo/

notes.title: October Update: New Demo & PGA 2024 Highlights
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/e2e427c902a84da6d634a94505236bbcae2cacc9.png[/img]
[h3]Welcome![/h3]

If you haven’t been following us on Discord recently (be sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/J9rtH5rVun]join our Discord[/url]), we recently attended Poznań Game Arena 2024, organized in collaboration with the Indie Games Poland Foundation. Huge thanks to them and our fellow exhibitors, especially [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863790/FolkOrigin]FolkOrigin[/url], who had a booth next to ours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/119234db88b950418ccbbe35eba626e7e4017c6e.jpg[/img]

Alongside our immersive booth setup, we showcased a new private demo at the event! And guess what... we’ve just released [b]a new update for the public demo on Steam[/b]. Now you can try out the new features yourself!

[h3]Changelog - Update 0.15.6-demo:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New character in the Hub - Zosia. You can chat with her in Hub Levels 2, 4, and 6.[/b]
[*] [b]New gameplay mechanic - Frequency Match. Use the arrow keys to match upcoming frequencies.[/b]
[*] Level 5 has been completely reworked for the new QTE mechanics.
[*] All levels are now better balanced for gameplay.
[*] Added a sound effect when you enter the "Missed" state during gameplay.
[*] Added highlights to specific parts of Morse code to assist with learning (we’re continuing to work on progression and learning features).
[*] Weather now affects the Hub and Gameplay, enhancing the emotional depth of the story.
[*] Improved Main Menu visuals.
[*] And much more...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624387/a4ac1fb07a21b5cd76d6a4141d9c831e49fbe3d2.jpg[/img]
[i]Even [url=https://www.instagram.com/lynx.den]Lara Croft[/url] enjoyed playing our new demo of Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War! <3[/i]

Godspeed!
